name: Power Array (Thaumaturgy (Path of the Levinbolt), Intermediate)

system.description: You hold a charge of up to three shocking strikes (three levels of lethal damage each, stunning the target) that arcs into anyone who touches you, and can channel it through any metal object you hold, adding its effects to a weapon's damage. By touching both a power source and a subject, you become a living conductor, siphoning electricity from lines or batteries into whatever you touch without harm to yourself. The charge lasts a number of turns equal to your permanent Willpower Traits, or until spent.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
